EXECUTIVE ORDER
Revocation of Executive Order No.
5789 of February 2, 1932, and Partial
Revocation of Executive Order No.
5792 of February 2, 1932, Withdraw­
ing Public Lands, California and
Nevada
By virtue of and pursuant to the au­
thority vested in the President by the
act of June 25, 1910, c. 421, 36 Stat. 847,
as amended by the act of August 24,’
1912, c. 369, 37 Stat. 497, I hereby re­
voke (1) Executive Order No. 5789 of
February 2, 1932, withdrawing public
lands in California pending a resurvey,
as to the remainder of the lands affected
thereby, and (2) Executive Order No.
5792 of February 2, 1932, withdrawing
public lands in Nevada pending a resur­
vey, as to the remainder of the lands
affected thereby, except those therein de­
scribed in T. 26 S., R. 58 E. of the
Mount Diablo meridian, both of these
orders having been heretofore partially
revoked by Executive Order No. 6720 of
May 25, 1934.
